correctness.rationale: The invariant measure satisfies pi_i r_i=J. On the planes a=c or b=d an explicit parity-preserving reflection conjugates the stationary time-reversed generator to the clockwise one. When both differences are nonzero, exact shortest-path enumeration gives P(0101)-P(1010)=-J(a-c)(b-d)h^3+O(h^4), proving the converse. For any stationary binary word law of length four, balance of adjacent three-letter blocks reduces all reversal differences to this single one. The other five reversal pairs have probabilities at least order h^2 and asymmetry order h^3, and thus contribute only O(h^4) to four-word KL, while the alternating pair contributes the claimed strictly positive cubic term. Numerical regression and exact-rational tests passed 1036 checks; they do not substitute for the universal proof.

value.rationale: For a four-stage unidirectional molecular cycle observed only through an alternating binary reporter, the full time-reversal-invariance locus consists of precisely two physically meaningful opposite-rate matching surfaces. All two- or three-snapshot measurements are direction-blind, but four snapshots expose the current with a sharp explicit cubic KL coefficient. This is an exact and natural diagnostic phase diagram for the smallest hidden cyclic architecture beyond the known three-state obstruction, not merely a standalone algebraic exercise. The singular microscopic dissipation and fine-step restriction are made explicit.
